_nota: Esercizio Brand 1. La guida del brand e i commenti sono inventati.
titolo: Exercise 1 · Cinque Foglie's tone of voice

richiesta.testo: Hi! Each of us writes differently on the website, social media and newsletter. Can you help me work out which sentences are "very Cinque Foglie", choose our values and fix a couple of style rules?

voci: Helping people discover quality tea, calmly and kindly
People aged 25-45 who love small rituals

consiglio: A tone of voice is recognisable even without a logo: ask yourself whether each sentence "sounds" like Cinque Foglie.

parti.titolo: Is it a Cinque Foglie sentence?
parti.testo: For each sentence choose whether it fits the brand's personality.

righe.testo: Take a break: your Sencha is waiting for you.
We'll show you how to brew it, step by step.
LAST HOURS!!! Buy now or you'll regret it
The tea that will change your life
We're number one, the others copy us

controlli.suggerimento: Calm, useful sentences are exactly Cinque Foglie.
Capitals, exclamation marks and threats aren't "never pushy".
A tea doesn't change your life: it's an exaggeration.
Boasting at others' expense isn't kind.

parti.perche: A consistent tone of voice makes the brand recognisable everywhere. False urgency or exaggeration loses trust, and some aggressive practices are banned by consumer protection law.
parti.soluzione: On brand: "Take a break...", "We'll show you how to brew it...". Off tone: the other three.

spiega.testo: Reread the personality on the card (kind, clear, expert, never pushy). For each sentence ask yourself: would a person like that say it? Shouting, rushing people, exaggerating or boasting are signs of an off-tone sentence.
spiega.esempio: For the friendly bookshop: "Come by for a chat about books" is on brand; "TODAY ONLY OR NEVER AGAIN!" rushes people and is off tone.

parti.testo: Which group of values best describes Cinque Foglie, looking at the card?

opzioni.testo: Calm, quality, respect for the environment
Speed, value for money, constant deals

controlli.suggerimento: Reread the mission: calm and kindness.
A value is credible if a fact proves it (e.g. the compostable packaging).
Everyone says "quality and passion": what makes us different?

parti.perche: A brand's values must be true and provable. Claiming to be "green" without proof is greenwashing, and EU Directive 2024/825 bans generic environmental claims without proof.
parti.soluzione: Calm, quality, respect for the environment: they come from the mission and are proven by whole leaves and compostable packaging.

spiega.testo: A good value comes from the mission and can be proven with a fact from the card. Discard the groups about something else (speed, technology) and the ones too generic, which would suit any company.
spiega.esempio: "Quality, passion, excellence" could be said by a garage or a bank: it says nothing specific.

parti.testo: Choose the right rules for the brand guidelines.

campi.etichetta: Text colour on the orange button
Minimum text size on the website

controlli.suggerimento: White on orange has a contrast of 2.6:1: too low. Dark brown reaches about 6:1.
Below 16 px, paragraph text is hard to read, especially on a phone.

controlli.nome: Logo always readable and never distorted
controlli.suggerimento: The logo is never distorted and needs a calm background.

parti.perche: A consistent brand is also accessible: the WCAG guidelines ask for a contrast of at least 4.5:1 for normal text. Since 2025, with the European Accessibility Act, many online shops in the EU must be accessible.
parti.soluzione: Dark brown text on the orange button, text at least 16 px, logo on a light box and never distorted.

spiega.testo: For each rule think about the reader: the text on the button must be easy to read (high contrast), the website text mustn't be too small, the logo must stay recognisable, so never distorted and never on a busy background.
spiega.esempio: A yellow button with white text has little contrast; with dark text it's much easier to read.

parti.testo: Under a post a customer writes: "The parcel arrived 3 days late, I'm never ordering again!". Which reply do you publish?

opzioni.testo: Hi Giulia, you're right and we're really sorry. We'll message you privately to find out what happened and make it right.
The delay isn't our fault, it's the courier's. We always ship within 24 hours.
Oops! The tea was so good the courier drank it on the way, haha!
Dear customer, your report has been received. Kind regards.

controlli.suggerimento: First you acknowledge the problem, without blaming others.
What will you do to make it right?
Neither jokes nor form-letter phrases: warm and clear.

parti.perche: Replies to comments are public: everyone reads them. A kind, concrete reply can turn criticism into trust.
parti.soluzione: The first: it acknowledges the problem, apologises and offers to make it right privately.

spiega.testo: A good public reply does three things: it admits what went wrong, apologises plainly and moves the conversation to private messages to solve it. Avoid replies that shift the blame, ones that joke and cold form-letter ones.
spiega.esempio: "Hi Marco, you're right, we're sorry. We'll message you privately to sort it out straight away" is warm and concrete; "Your request has been forwarded" sounds like a robot.

aiuti.titolo: How do I recognise an off-tone sentence?
aiuti.testo: Compare it with the personality on the card: kind, clear, expert, never pushy. If it rushes people, exaggerates or attacks someone, it's off tone.
The difference in brightness between text and background. The higher it is, the easier it is to read. Normal text needs at least 4.5:1.

glossario: Tone of voice: the way a brand speaks. Values: the things it believes in, proven by facts. Contrast: how much the text stands out from the background.
note: The tone of voice comes from the brand's personality, not from the writer's taste.
Values must be true, provable and distinctive.
Style rules also make the brand accessible to everyone.
autovalutazione: I could explain why a sentence is off tone.
I understood why values must be proven by facts.
I understood what contrast between text and background is for.
I could reply to criticism while staying in the brand's tone.
rispostaCollega: Perfect, now we have common ground. I'll put the rules in the brand guidelines and send them to the whole team.

lezione.intro: A brand is the idea people form of a company: not just the logo, but how it speaks, what it believes in and how it behaves. A brand manager writes the rules that keep everything consistent, so that a post, an email or a reply to a customer seem written by the same person.

concetti.spiegazione: It's the way the brand speaks: formal or friendly, calm or shouted, technical or simple. It comes from the brand's personality and is used everywhere, from the website to comments.
concetti.esempio: A kind, passionate neighbourhood bookshop writes "We recommend a mystery for tonight's rain", not "MEGA BOOK DEAL!!!".

concetti.spiegazione: They're the things the brand believes in. They only count if the facts prove them: saying "sustainable" without being so is misleading. Generic words like "excellence" or "passion" are used by everyone and set nobody apart.
concetti.esempio: The bookshop that runs free readings for children can say it believes in culture for everyone: there's a fact that proves it.

concetti.spiegazione: Colours, typefaces and logo have precise rules. An important one is contrast: text must stand out clearly from the background, otherwise many people can't read it (accessibility guidelines ask for at least 4.5 to 1 for normal text).
concetti.esempio: Light grey text on a white background is elegant but hard to read; almost-black text on white is always readable.

concetti.spiegazione: Tone shows most when something goes wrong. A good reply acknowledges the problem, genuinely apologises and offers a solution, without shifting the blame and without joking about an inconvenience.
concetti.esempio: A book arrives damaged: "We're sorry, we'll send you a new copy today" works; "It must be the courier's fault" doesn't.

cosaFarai: Recognise which sentences sound like Cinque Foglie
Fix some visual rules in the guidelines
Reply to an angry customer in the right tone
